method.value: [CI] luminosity to carbon mass, then H2 mass via X_[CI] and He correction; SFE = SFR/M_H2

evidence.quote: We assume local thermodynamic equilibrium, that the \[C i\] lines are optically thin, and that the excitation factor $Q_{21}$=0.5.

assumptions.value: LTE, optically thin, Q21 = 0.5; cosmology H0=70, OmegaM=0.3, OmegaL=0.7; Kroupa IMF
